cli.usage_head:
OpenOrbit — AI memory, retrospectives and plugins for this PC

Commands:
flag.hook.launcher: with --runtime: who asked orbit-pi for the session (studio, telegram, workflow…); default ORBIT_LAUNCHER or orbit-pi
flag.hook.runtime: orbit-pi only: the runtime that started this session calls the hook itself (ORBIT_RUNTIME=orbit-pi turns the plugin hooks off)
flag.hook.skip_lists: leave list tools to the synchronous hook and do not record them
flag.inject.cwd: working directory that picks the project scope
flag.inject.host: host name recorded with the use event
flag.inject.session: session id, to keep the session bundle stable
flag.install.apply_target: file or directory retrospectives may propose changes to (repeatable)
flag.install.dry_run: only show what would be done
flag.install.enable_codex_plan: turn on the Codex plan tool (update_plan) in ~/.codex/config.toml (keeps a copy first)
flag.install.no_hosts: skip registering the plugin in the hosts
flag.install.plugin_source: OpenOrbit plugin source directory (empty: the source built into the binary; remembered once given)
flag.lab.change: folder holding the changed files at the same relative paths as the source
flag.lab.proposal: id of a file change proposal waiting for the lab
flag.lab.title: task title
flag.mcp.reader: for readers such as Orbit Studio: opens only the four work tools (work_list, work_get, work_sessions, work_changes) and memory_graph
flag.mcp.retro: retrospective id (opens only the tools of that retrospective run)
flag.migrate.from: copy of the old Knowledge SQLite
flag.plugin.out: output directory (default: parent of the source)
flag.proposals.body_file: file with the body to approve with
flag.proposals.title: title to approve with
flag.retro.week: Monday of the week for the weekly retrospective
flag.stats.days: number of days up to today
usage.backup: orb backup   # copies the memory DB now
usage.hook: orb hook session-start|prompt|session-end|work --host claude|codex [--skip-lists]   # host hooks (stdin JSON)
usage.inject: orb inject session-start|prompt [--cwd DIR] [--session ID] [--host orbit-pi]   # memory context for orbit-pi as JSON (prompt on stdin)
usage.install: orb install [--bin-dir D] [--retro-host claude|codex] [--retro-model M] [--plugin-source DIR] [--apply-target PATH]... [--no-schedule] [--no-hosts] [--enable-codex-plan] [--dry-run]
usage.lab: orb lab task new --title T --instruction(-file) X --criteria(-file) X [--start DIR] [--from-corrections ID,…] | task list | candidates | drop <proposal> [--note N] | run --task T (--change DIR | --proposal ID) | show <id> | list [--json]   # harness lab
usage.ledger: orb ledger [--all] [--n N] [--json]   # approved changes and their effect verdicts
usage.mcp: orb mcp [--retro ID | --reader]   # MCP server the hosts start (stdio). --reader is read-only work records and memory graph
usage.plugin: orb plugin build <source> [--out D] [--check] [--var k=v]... | install <built marketplace directory>
usage.profile: orb profile [args…]   # orbit-pi engine and model profiles
usage.proposals: orb proposals [list|review|show <id>|approve <id> [--title T] [--body B|--body-file F] [--note N]|reject <id> [--note N]] [--all]
usage.retro: orb retro run [--day YYYY-MM-DD|--week YYYY-MM-DD] | sessions | tidy | legacy | status [--n N] | material --day YYYY-MM-DD   # tidy: tidy the memory graph once now, legacy: judge one batch of old memories
usage.run: orb run [args…]   # plan, run and verify a request with the orbit-pi orchestrator (orb with no arguments opens its TUI on a terminal)
usage.runtime: orb runtime install|update|status [--ref R] [--repo URL] [--json]   # orbit-pi, the agent runtime (needs git and Node 22.19+)
usage.stats: orb stats [--days N | --week YYYY-MM-DD (a Monday)] [--json]   # corrections, recall, use verdicts, ledger, proposals and retrospective metrics
usage.uninstall: orb uninstall   # removes the plugin registration and schedule; keeps the memory DB
usage.work: orb work emit | get | list | mcp …   # OpenOrbit's work record (openorbit-work): emit reads JSON lines on stdin, get and list print orbit.work JSON, mcp is its MCP server for apps such as Orbit Studio and orbit-pi (work and decision card tools)
usage.daemon: orb daemon <start|status|stop|serve|enable|disable|device|call|watch>   # orbit-pi daemon: Connect RPC on loopback for Orbit Studio
cli.daemon.enabled: The daemon now starts at login: %s (log %s)
cli.daemon.disabled: The daemon no longer starts at login.
